# DGO State Budget 2026: Social Security forecast

The [Direção-Geral do Orçamento (DGO)](https://www.dgo.gov.pt/politicaorcamental/OrcamentodeEstado/OE2026_doc16_Relatorio.pdf)
publishes Portugal's State Budget 2026 report. **Quadro 4.17**, “Principais
receitas e despesas da Segurança Social”, reports amounts in **millions of
euros** for the proposed 2026 Social Security budget (OSS 2026).

| Quantity | Amount | Classification |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Social Security global balance, OSS 2026 | €6,438.5m | **2026 budget forecast** |
| 2025 execution comparison printed in the same table | €5,635.0m | **2025 forecast vintage**, not audited execution |

Source: [OE2026 report, Quadro 4.17](https://www.dgo.gov.pt/politicaorcamental/OrcamentodeEstado/OE2026_doc16_Relatorio.pdf).
The report is also listed on the [DGO Budget page](https://www.dgo.gov.pt/politicaorcamental/Paginas/OrcamentosEstado.aspx?Ano=2026&TipoOE=Proposta+de+Or%C3%A7amento+do+Estado).

This forecast must **not** be spliced into CFP's observed, differently
adjusted series as a realised 2026 Social Security surplus. In particular,
the subsequent CFP 04/2026 report's **observed adjusted 2025 balance of
€6,657m** is not numerically or conceptually interchangeable with the
2025 forecast comparator above. Budgeted surplus does not establish an
entitlement to redirect contributions or FEFSS reserves to housing.

This is a **source-link record**, not a pinned binary snapshot. The research
project uses the forecast as an illustrative scenario starting point; its
allocation shares, rents, discount rates and construction assumptions are
separately hypothetical. No source PDF or derived model data is stored here.
The report's dataset-specific redistribution terms remain unverified.
